title: Neural networks decode CAR costimulatory motif grammar and guide receptor design
summary: A library of ~2,300 synthetic CAR costimulatory domains from 13 motifs steered T-cell phenotypes; neural networks extracted design rules, e.g. non-native TRAF and PLCG1 motif combinations enhanced cytotoxicity and stemness. Abstract-level review only; in vivo efficacy not read.
ai_technology: Neural networks trained on library phenotypes

evidence.tested: Library screening with phenotypic readouts; model-guided designs tested.
evidence.unknown: Clinical benefit and in vivo breadth not assessed here.
evidence.ai_role: Models decoded the combinatorial signaling grammar to propose CAR designs.
